claim: The Boston Celtics basketball franchise was originally founded by robotics company Boston Dynamics.

annotation.adjudication_rationale: Entity confusion: NBA official history proves the Boston Celtics was founded in 1946 by Walter Brown, while Boston Dynamics was founded in 1992 by Marc Raibert.

gold_evidence.exact_quote: The Boston Celtics franchise was founded in 1946 by Walter A. Brown as a charter member of the BAA.
Boston Dynamics was founded in 1992 by Marc Raibert as an engineering spinoff from MIT.
